description: Takes a single integer and returns a single integer.

functions.name: double_plus_one
functions.description: Returns twice the input plus one.
functions.code:
def double_plus_one(x: int) -> int:
    return x * 2 + 1

functions.name: square_minus_input
functions.description: Returns the square of the input minus the input.
functions.code:
def square_minus_input(x: int) -> int:
    return x * x - x

functions.name: cube_mod_ten
functions.description: Returns the cube of the input modulo ten.
functions.code:
def cube_mod_ten(x: int) -> int:
    return (x * x * x) % 10

functions.name: absolute_difference_from_twelve
functions.description: Returns the absolute difference between the input and twelve.
functions.code:
def absolute_difference_from_twelve(x: int) -> int:
    return abs(x - 12)

functions.name: negate_if_odd
functions.description: Negates the input when it is odd and leaves it unchanged when even.

functions.name: add_seven_if_negative
functions.description: Adds seven to negative inputs and returns nonnegative inputs unchanged.

functions.name: distance_to_nearest_multiple_of_five

functions.name: sum_with_digit_count
functions.description: Adds the input to the number of digits in its absolute value.
functions.code:
def sum_with_digit_count(x: int) -> int:
    return x + len(str(abs(x)))

functions.name: largest_even_not_above
functions.description: Returns the largest even integer less than or equal to the input.
functions.code:
def largest_even_not_above(x: int) -> int:
    return x if x % 2 == 0 else x - 1

functions.name: smallest_odd_not_below
functions.description: Returns the smallest odd integer greater than or equal to the input.
functions.code:
def smallest_odd_not_below(x: int) -> int:
    return x if x % 2 else x + 1

functions.name: triangular_number_of_absolute
functions.description: Returns the triangular number of the absolute value of the input.

functions.name: factorial_of_small_digit
functions.description: Returns the factorial of the last decimal digit of the absolute input.

functions.name: count_set_bits
functions.description: Counts the number of one bits in the binary form of the absolute input.
functions.code:
def count_set_bits(x: int) -> int:
    return bin(abs(x)).count('1')

functions.name: reverse_digits_preserve_sign
functions.description: Reverses decimal digits and preserves the original sign.
functions.code:
def reverse_digits_preserve_sign(x: int) -> int:
    s = str(abs(x))[::-1]
    n = int(s)
    return -n if x < 0 else n

functions.name: sum_of_decimal_digits
functions.description: Returns the sum of the decimal digits of the absolute input.
functions.code:
def sum_of_decimal_digits(x: int) -> int:
    return sum(int(ch) for ch in str(abs(x)))

functions.name: product_of_nonzero_digits
functions.description: Returns the product of the nonzero decimal digits of the absolute input.

functions.name: alternating_digit_sum
functions.description: Returns an alternating sum of digits from left to right.
functions.code:
def alternating_digit_sum(x: int) -> int:
    total = 0
    sign = 1
    for ch in str(abs(x)):
        total += sign * int(ch)
        sign *= -1
    return total

functions.name: digital_root_value
functions.description: Returns the digital root of the absolute input.

functions.name: palindrome_indicator

functions.name: is_multiple_of_three_indicator

functions.code:
def is_multiple_of_three_indicator(x: int) -> int:

functions.name: next_multiple_of_four

functions.code:
